findings.title: Light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 70% for embedded-post author link
findings.body: This was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) before the PR, but the new dark-light-choose uses scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) as the light-theme argument and scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%) as the dark-theme argument. The pattern elsewhere is primary X% / secondary (100-X)%, so this should be 30%/70%. As written the light (default) theme link becomes much lighter/less contrasted than before, and the dark-theme value is also not the complement.

findings.title: Light/dark lightness values inverted for .custom-message-length
findings.body: This was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%) before the PR, but the new value is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)). The desktop counterpart in desktop/modal.scss correctly uses 70% for $primary and 30% for $secondary. As written mobile light-theme text becomes much darker than before and dark-theme text much lighter, inverting the intended shading.

findings.title: Light-theme lightness changed from 20% to 50% for topic-map h3
findings.body: This was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%) before the PR, but the new dark-light-choose uses 50% for both $primary and $secondary. The desktop counterpart in desktop/topic-post.scss correctly preserves 20% for $primary with 80% for $secondary. As written the mobile light-theme heading becomes significantly lighter/greyer than before, regressing the default theme, not just adding a dark-theme variant.

findings.title: Light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50% for group-member-info name
findings.body: The .group-member-info .name rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) before the PR, but the new dark-light-choose uses scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%) / scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%). Following the PR's own pattern it should be 30%/70%. As written names are rendered lighter in the light (default) theme than before, an unintended visual change beyond adding dark-theme support.

findings.title: Light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50% for group-member-info name
findings.body: The .group-member-info .name rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%) before the PR, but the new dark-light-choose uses scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%) / scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%). Following the PR's own pattern it should be 30%/70%. As written names are rendered lighter in the light (default) theme than before, an unintended visual change beyond adding dark-theme support.
